text: Write a custom exception carrying data a handler can act on. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: static void withdraw(long have, long want) {
if (want > have) throw new InsufficientFunds(want - have);
answer: final long shortfall|super("short by " + shortfall + " cents")|e.shortfall
explanation: Verified: `short by 4000 cents / 4000`. The field is the point — a handler that must parse the message string to learn the shortfall is a handler the exception has failed. Messages are for humans and fields are for code, and a handler reading `e.shortfall` keeps working when the wording changes. Note also that `super(...)` must come first, exactly as in any constructor.
